title: Rust toolchain
old_targets: Windows XP, Android API 21 (ARMv7, x86), Linux ARMv6 / ARMv7, PowerPC 32 / 64-bit, macOS 11, iOS 15
criterion: Build and execution of the PoC and of the core tests
fallback: XP: version abandoned or thin client; others: downgrade to tier C or target withdrawal
note: Not tested as worded: Rust was dropped by the project owner (spec Clarifications of 2026-11-12, ADR 0001), so no Rust toolchain was ever tried on any target. The same question for the C++11 backend that replaced it is answered elsewhere, and only in part: spike S1 (a MinGW-w64 C++11 static library runs on Windows 2000 build 2195 without a service pack; SP4 itself was not run) and spike S6 (strict C++11 and C-only exports checked with g++ 13.3.0 and clang++ 23.1.5 on Linux). Not tried at all: Windows XP, Android API 21, Linux ARM and PowerPC, macOS 11, iOS 15.

title: CPU engine performance
old_targets: API 21 (1 GB), ARM 32-bit, PowerPC, XP
criterion: §5.3 target reached on a modern machine; time measured and no memory overrun on the old ones
fallback: Resolution at 0.5 px, fewer lines, offloaded computation (server or file)
note: Not covered by this probe: the application only builds a greeting, no path is computed. Nothing was measured against the section 5.3 target.

title: Memory on 32-bit
old_targets: XP, ARM 32-bit, API 21
criterion: Peak under the budget (e.g. 512 MB out of 1 GB) at standard and reduced resolution
note: Not covered by this probe: no 512 MB budget case exists. The only memory figure is the peak working set of the greeting window (1,084 KB on Windows 2000, see the verdict), which says nothing about the path computation.

title: Cross-architecture consistency
old_targets: All, including big-endian
criterion: `.loomora` read back identically; equivalent paths within the documented tolerance
fallback: The file is authoritative; wider tolerance
note: Not covered by this probe: no .loomora file is written or read, and no big-endian system was available. The greeting returns identical text on every platform tested (SC-011 vectors), which is a different property.

title: GPU backend (`wgpu`)
old_targets: API 21–23 (OpenGL ES), API ≥ 24 (Vulkan), Windows ARM64 (DirectX 12), macOS / iOS (Metal), Linux
criterion: Reliable detection; compute shader executed; result equivalent to the CPU
fallback: CPU only on the target, automatic disabling
note: Not covered by this probe: there is no GPU engine. FR-015 only requires that the application works without graphics acceleration, which it does on the platforms tested.

title: FFI bridges
old_targets: Kotlin (UniFFI, API 21), Swift (iOS 15), C# (WinUI 3 x86 / x64 / ARM64), C (`cbindgen`, MFC / XP), Rust (GTK), WebAssembly
criterion: Round-trip calls with large volumes, callbacks, errors and threads; acceptable binary size
fallback: Hand-written JNI and C API; UniFFI abandoned on the target
note: Only the C API of the C++11 backend called from C++ was exercised: the Win32 Legacy UI (Windows 2000 and Windows 11), the Xlib Legacy UI and the gtkmm Modern UI (Linux), and on Android the hand-written JNI glue called from Java (Legacy UI, built for API 9, run on an API 16 emulator) and from Kotlin (Modern UI, API 24, run on an API 24 emulator). Spike S6 shows the exports are the 6 loomora_* C functions and that no exception crosses the boundary (allocation failures injected). Not exercised: large volumes, callbacks, threads, and every other bridge of the criterion (UniFFI, Swift, C# / WinUI 3 (spike S8 open), WebAssembly); cbindgen and Rust no longer exist in the project.

title: Android API 21 UI
old_targets: Jetpack Compose or Views
criterion: Smooth 5,000-segment path on 1 GB; themes; RTL
note: Not covered by this probe as worded: a UI of Android API 21 under load was not measured. Android UIs do exist now: the Legacy UI (Java views, built for API 9, run on an API 16 emulator) and the Modern UI (Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, minSdk 24, run on an API 24 emulator); they only show a greeting, so no 5,000-segment path, no theme or RTL case was tried. The floor moved: spike S8 measured that the pinned Compose and AndroidX libraries need minSdk 23 and the owner set the Modern floor to 24, with the Legacy UI covering API 9 to 23.

title: iOS 15 UI
old_targets: SwiftUI
criterion: Same; light, dark and contrast themes
note: Not covered by this probe: no iOS build or trial exists (spikes S2 and S7 open).

title: Windows UI
old_targets: WinUI 3 (minimum Windows version to be set); MFC on XP (`v141_xp`)
criterion: Preview screen, list, dialog boxes, printing; themes drawn on XP
note: Only the Windows Legacy UI that replaced MFC (C++ on the plain Win32 API, one source for Windows 2000 to 11, spec Clarifications of 2026-11-12) was tried, on Windows 2000 build 2195 (VirtualBox) and Windows 11: a text field and a label. Not exercised: preview screen, list, dialog boxes, printing, and every Windows XP case (no XP system was tried; MFC is dropped, so 'MFC on XP' cannot be answered). WinUI 3 has no build or trial (spike S8 open).

title: Linux UI
old_targets: GTK 4 versus Slint on Ubuntu 20.04, Debian 11, ARM 32-bit; Flatpak and AppImage
criterion: Starts; Arabic, CJK and RTL correct; high contrast
note: Tried on Ubuntu 24.04 in WSL2 only: the GTK 3 / gtkmm Modern UI (GTK 4 only as a build option) and the Xlib Legacy UI start and show the greeting; Arabic, CJK and RTL were looked at in screenshots (Modern: correct with one font set; Legacy: no shaping and no bidirectional layout, by decision). Not tried: Ubuntu 20.04, Debian 11, ARM 32-bit, Slint, AppImage (Flatpak is excluded by the spec). High contrast was forced with GTK_THEME on the earlier C build only.

title: SQLite persistence
old_targets: All, including XP, ARM 32-bit and big-endian
criterion: Synchronous write at each nail; survives abrupt shutdown and power cut; acceptable latency on slow storage
note: Not covered by this probe: the application stores nothing (spec Assumptions).

title: Embedded server and QR
old_targets: XP (without `tokio`), Android client (cleartext HTTP, API ≥ 28), iOS (local network)
criterion: PC → phone transfer with resume (`Range`)
note: Not covered by this probe: no network access exists; FR-013 only requires that none is opened.

title: Bluetooth Low Energy
old_targets: Android API 21, iOS 15, Windows 10, macOS 11, Linux (BlueZ); XP excluded
criterion: Transfer of 15 to 40 KB with CRC, negotiated MTU and resume
note: Not covered by this probe: no Bluetooth code exists.

title: System voice
old_targets: Android API 21, iOS 15, Windows (SAPI from XP to 11), macOS, Linux
criterion: Multilingual synthesis and recognition of 3 words; absence handled by clean disabling
note: Not covered by this probe: no speech synthesis or recognition exists.

title: i18n, RTL and fonts
old_targets: All native UIs, XP
criterion: Arabic, Hindi and Chinese text rendered correctly; RTL; language pack imported without recompiling; acceptable application size
note: Partly covered, through the greeting vectors only (accents, CJK, right-to-left, emoji). Windows 2000 draws the accents but not CJK and emoji (the fonts of that system have no such glyphs; the text itself is exact); Linux Legacy draws logical order left to right, with no shaping or bidi, by owner decision; Linux Modern is correct with Noto fonts installed. Not covered: Hindi shaping on the Legacy UIs, a layout switch to RTL, language packs imported without recompiling, Windows XP, every other family.

title: Printing and PDF
old_targets: XP (GDI), Android Print, AirPrint, CUPS
criterion: 1:1 template at the measured scale; correct tiling
note: Not covered by this probe: no printing and no PDF.

title: PWA / WebAssembly
old_targets: Recent and old browsers, iOS Safari
criterion: Working Wasm engine (threads, SIMD); acceptable performance; OPFS storage; memory limits respected
note: Not covered by this probe: no web build or trial exists (spike S5 open).

title: 3D
old_targets: BVH on 32-bit, API 21, XP; `wgpu` surfaces in `SurfaceView`, `SwapChainPanel`, `GLArea`
criterion: 100,000 triangles and 500 nails: admissibility matrix in acceptable time; smooth 3D view
note: Not covered by this probe: no 3D, no mesh.

title: Themes and contrast
old_targets: All
criterion: Contrast ratios verified automatically; system high contrast detected
note: Partly covered. Windows 11: light theme in the trial; light and dark both shown with the Legacy UI in the ADR 0004 re-run; high contrast not exercised. Linux Modern: dark and high contrast forced with GTK_THEME on the earlier C build (contrast ratios 10.56 to 13.88, not re-run on the gtkmm build), not through the desktop settings. The Windows Legacy UI reads the system high contrast flag, not exercised with a scheme on. Not covered: macOS, Android, iOS, web, Windows 2000 beyond system colours.

title: Distribution and signing
old_targets: Play (16 KB pages, `targetSdk`), App Store, macOS notarization, Flatpak / AppImage, XP installer and accepted signature
criterion: One installable package per platform
note: Not covered by this probe: no package, installer, signature or store submission was made. The Windows deliverable is a plain executable and the Linux ones are plain executables built on the target (ADR 0007).
